svg.aria-label: A star schema for retail. Three dimension tables across the top - retail calendar, product and store - each connect down to two fact tables: sales at store, SKU and day grain, and a stock snapshot at store, SKU and week grain. A crossed-out dashed line between the two fact tables marks that they are never related to each other; they meet only through the shared dimensions.

text.font-family: Inter Tight, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
